commit: fix(resolve): fix resolve cache to consider `conditions` and more

truth.description: getResolveCacheKey keys a package's cached entry by conditions but not by overrideConditions, which resolveExportsOrImports uses in place of conditions, and fetchModule's externalizing tryNodeResolve call passes empty conditions with each environment's externalConditions in overrideConditions, so every dev environment sharing the config's packageCache gets the same key and an externalized package resolves to whichever entry the first environment cached instead of its own externalConditions entry.

distractions.why: The browser field is only consulted when webCompatible is set and webCompatible is part of the key, so the stored browserExternalId is read back only by web-compatible lookups, as the removed web-only map did.
